TenancyNode.title: TenancyNode
TenancyNode.description: A tenancy hierarchy node: typed id (prefix = kind), kind, an opaque parent-id reference (null only for the platform root), and an optional display name.

TenancyRecordVersion.title: TenancyRecordVersion
TenancyRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized tenancy document (currently 1).

TenancyNodeId.title: TenancyNodeId
TenancyNodeId.description: Typed tenancy-node identity: a known kind prefix ("tenant:", "workspace:", ...) followed by a lowercase slug; the prefix encodes the node kind.

TenancyNodeKind.title: TenancyNodeKind
TenancyNodeKind.description: Tenancy hierarchy level: platform, tenant, workspace, project, or the project-scoped leaves world/scenario/evidence.
